title: Race finishing order
prompt: Return each runner's name and their finishing rank (1 = fastest) as row_num, using ROW_NUMBER() ordered by finish_time ascending.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE runners (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, finish_time REAL); INSERT INTO runners VALUES (1,'Alice',12.5),(2,'Bob',11.2),(3,'Carol',13.0),(4,'Dave',10.8);
reference_sql: SELECT name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY finish_time ASC) AS row_num FROM runners;
